# Third-party code

The official VGGT repository will be cloned as `external/vggt` at an explicitly recorded commit after approval. Do not copy it into `src/` and do not edit it locally.

The official TartanAir toolkit may be cloned as `external/tartanairpy`. Its
reproducibility pin is tracked in `external/TARTANAIRPY_PIN.json`; the checkout
itself is ignored and must not be edited.
